s.n: Safari camp beef samosas with mint yoghurt
s.how: Fry 400g beef mince with 1 diced onion and 2 crushed garlic cloves until browned. Add 2 tsp curry powder, 1 tsp garam masala, 1 grated carrot and 100g peas and cook 5 minutes. Stir through chopped coriander and cool. Cut 6 spring roll wrappers into 3 strips each, place a spoon of filling at one end and fold into triangles, sealing with water. Fry at 180C for 3 minutes until golden. Mix 200g Greek yoghurt with chopped mint and a pinch of salt for dipping.

s.n: Monastery momos with chilli tomato sauce
s.note: the mountain monastery where the film begins
s.how: Mix 400g pork mince with 1 tbsp grated ginger, 2 crushed garlic cloves, 3 sliced spring onions, 1 tbsp soy and 1 tsp sesame oil. Place a teaspoon in the centre of each of 24 round dumpling wrappers, wet the edges and pleat closed. Steam in a lined steamer over boiling water for 10 minutes. For the sauce, blitz 2 tomatoes, 2 red chillies, 1 garlic clove, a pinch of salt and 1 tbsp vinegar and simmer 5 minutes.

m.how: Marinate 1kg chicken thigh fillets with the juice of 2 lemons, 3 crushed garlic cloves, 1 tsp chilli flakes, 1 tsp paprika, 2 tbsp oil and salt for 1 hour. For chapati, mix 300g plain flour, 1 tsp salt, 2 tbsp oil and 180ml warm water, knead and rest 20 minutes, then roll into 8 rounds and dry-fry 1 minute a side. Grill the chicken 6 minutes a side. Toss 3 diced tomatoes, 1 red onion, coriander and lime juice for the kachumbari.

w.how: Mix 300g self-raising flour, 60g caster sugar, 1 tsp ground cardamom and a pinch of salt. Stir in 200ml coconut milk and 1 egg to make a soft dough, knead 2 minutes and rest 15 minutes. Roll out to 1cm thick and cut into 16 triangles. Fry in oil at 170C for 2 minutes a side until puffed and golden. Drain and toss in 60g caster sugar. Serve warm with honey.

d.note: the hunt for the sacred white bat
d.how: Heat 80g caster sugar with 80ml water and a few slices of fresh ginger until dissolved, then cool and strain. Scoop the pulp from 6 passionfruit into a jug. Add the juice of 3 limes and the ginger syrup and stir well. Fill 4 tall glasses with crushed ice, divide the passionfruit mix between them and top each with 200ml soda water. Stir and finish with mint sprigs.
